items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f6eeeed20a08f5f3dd93187564b7f266d1667736/image.png)

An FMC and FTO competition to see off 2024!

Due to the small size of this competition, all competitors will be expected to help judge/run while they are not competing.

**This competition will not feature 3x3 or other official speedsolving events. It is not recommended that new competitors register for this competition.**

items.information:

**A Week in Ashfield** is a series of five competitions from December 26, 2024 to December 30, 2024. You may only compete in one of these five competitions. They are listed below. 
[A Thursday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AThursdayinAshfield2024) (12/26/2024)
[A Friday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AFridayinAshfield2024) (12/27/2024)
[A Saturday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ASaturdayinAshfield2024) (12/28/2024)
[A Sunday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ASundayinAshfield2024) (12/29/2024)
[A Monday in Ashfield](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AMondayinAshfield2024) (12/30/2024)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.
